name: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program
note: established as the Food Stamp Program by the Food Stamp Act of 1964; renamed SNAP in 2008

name: Temporary Assistance for Needy Families
agency: US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
note: created by the Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act (PRWORA), replacing AFDC

name: Medicare
agency: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)
note: enacted 30 July 1965 as part of the Social Security Amendments of 1965, signed by President Johnson

name: Medicaid
agency: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) + individual states
note: enacted the same day as Medicare, 30 July 1965, in the same Act

name: Small Business Administration
note: created by the Small Business Act of 1953
